note: Beta 3.7 (owner 2026-10-25, ADR-036): which foods come from the UK's Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset 2021 (CoFID, gov.uk copy, Open Government Licence v3.0). `replace`: a FITOS composite estimate of the same dish takes CoFID's measured-as-eaten values per 100 g at FITOS's own serving (the food keeps its slug, name, serving and aliases); a dish carried from the mess estimate table is never listed here, so the food and the mess menu always agree (those are calibrated in packages/core mess/nutrition.ts instead). `foods`: plain foods FITOS did not have. Matches were reviewed by hand: a UK dish that is cooked differently (baked samosa, cream kulfi) is not used.
oilNote: Beta 3.9 (owner 2026-10-26, ADR-036 amendment): fried dishes CoFID measured as eaten. They calibrate the oil kept in INDB's deep-fried recipes, per kind of fried food (apps/api food-seed sources.ts FRIED_KINDS), and are never foods themselves.
